definition: Semantic HTML uses meaningful elements like header, nav, main, section and footer to improve accessibility and document structure.
CSS Grid is a two-dimensional layout system used to build responsive page layouts.
Flexbox is a one-dimensional layout model that aligns and distributes space among items.
The Fetch API allows JavaScript to request resources asynchronously from a server.
The Document Object Model represents the structure of an HTML document and allows JavaScript to manipulate it.
Local Storage allows websites to store data in the browser that persists after the page is closed.
